supplementalGtfsProvenance.translationField: translations.txt.trans_id exact original-text key joined to stops.stop_name; translationLanguage=EN
supplementalGtfsProvenance.coordinates: Exact stops.latitude/longitude rows for referenced source stop IDs in the immutable reference built from the feed above. These cases score exact stop-reference identity and introduce no distance tolerance.

supplementalOsmAddressProvenance.derivationMethod: Single read-only node pass; require addr:housenumber and addr:street; accept only addr:street:he/en or addr:full:he/en, with equivalent full_address/fulladdress spellings; retain best explicit-label candidate per 0.25-degree cell, then select up to six geographically spread nodes per language. Coordinates come from each source node.
supplementalOsmAddressProvenance.addressNodeFilter: node with non-empty addr:housenumber and addr:street
supplementalOsmAddressProvenance.acceptedLabels: explicit addr:street:he/en or explicit language-tagged full-address fields; no language inferred from script
supplementalOsmAddressProvenance.coordinates: source node latitude and longitude; no API-derived targets
supplementalOsmAddressProvenance.scannerHashScope: Final scanner source after stdout UTF-8-only repair; the PBF scan was not rerun
supplementalOsmAddressProvenance.scanElapsedTimingMethod: Approximate elapsed time from the host command and polling wall-time reports
supplementalOsmAddressProvenance.scanCommandExitExplanation: Selected findings were written successfully; the post-write console print hit Windows cp1252 on a Hebrew label, then scanner stdout was repaired without rerunning the scan
